neighbours.label: ' to' of purpose after a keyboard or input instruction ('Press Ctrl+S to save')
fire: Hold Alt and press Tab to switch between open windows.
In the editor, hit Ctrl+F to search the current file.
Press Escape to close the dialog without saving.
Use Shift+Delete to remove the email permanently.
On a Mac, press Command+Space to open Spotlight.
Press and hold the power button for ten seconds to force a restart.
Type Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen the tab you just closed.
Press F2 to rename the selected file.
quiet: Holding Alt and pressing Tab switches between open windows.
In the editor, Ctrl+F searches the current file.
Pressing Escape closes the dialog without saving.
On a Mac, Command+Space opens Spotlight.
Holding the power button for ten seconds forces a restart.
Ctrl+Shift+T reopens the tab you just closed.
F2 renames the selected file in most file managers.
